newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Noel to spend US$7.3 mln in property deal.
newsitem.headline: Noel to spend US$7.3 mln in property deal.

text.p: Singapore's Noel Gifts International Ltd said on Tuesday it had begun a diversification into property by agreeing to spend 4.5 million pounds sterling (US$7.3 million) on a residential portfolio in London.
"This acquisition is Noel's first foray into the overseas property market and marks its diversification into property investment and development," the company said in a statement.
It said the company was looking to broaden its earnings base from core businesses of design, marketing and distribution of floral arrangements, gifts and hampers.
Noel had paid a deposit of 450,000 pounds for 10 appartments and two maisonettes in London's fashionable Bayswater district, it said.
The firm said it would pay the balance in three instalments between June and September 1997.

The deal, to be approved by shareholders, would be financed by a mixture of internal resources and bank borrowings and the acquisition was not expected to have any material impact on current year earnings, the statement said.
